description.value: Chaise Lounge on Main Street is a neighbourhood bar and restaurant in South Main Vancouver, known for its lively atmosphere, craft beer selection, and daily food features. The venue offers a heated streetside patio ideal for people-watching, as well as a full dining room and bar. The menu spans small plates, flatbreads, salads, and brunch, with a solid range of vegetarian options.
